name: Element Interactivity as a Boundary Condition for Disfluency
fact: The effect of disfluent instructional material on learning is moderated by element interactivity: low interactivity leads to positive learning outcomes, while high interactivity leads to negative impacts on learning efficiency and extraneous load.
boundary: Instructional texts with varying element interactivity.
